dedupe_keys.name: worldpop and grid3 census based gridded population estimates african countries

description: These country datasets give gridded population estimates built from national census data by the WorldPop Research Group at the University of Southampton as part of GRID3 (Geo-Referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development), a project funded by the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office with partners UNFPA, CIESIN at Columbia University and the Flowminder Foundation, working with national statistics offices that provide and review census data. The Burkina Faso 2019 release, for example, includes a gridded population GeoTIFF, age and sex structure rasters, a mastergrid, methods and README documents, SQL and map tiles. The cross-cutting harvest queued releases for Burkina Faso (2019), South Sudan (2019, adjusted for displacement), Kenya (2021), Mali (2020), Mozambique (2017) and Niger (2021), each with a DOI and recommended citation. They are published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange as downloadable GeoTIFF, PDF and ZIP files, mostly under CC BY and the South Sudan release under CC BY-SA. Caveats: estimates are modelled and tied to each census year, each country release has its own methods document, and one release uses a share-alike licence. They provide population exposure layers for hazard exposure, emergency response and service capacity planning models; a related record is the Meta high-resolution population density maps.
name: WorldPop and GRID3 census-based gridded population estimates (African countries)
